technical-summary: Generalized MRC01 metric groups and query qualification beyond decode/prefill/TTFT; added typed metric metadata and versioned namespaced extension payloads. Archived KLD data migration remains deferred until the new schema is released, to avoid making records unreadable by deployed v1 readers.
user-summary-candidate: Run records can now represent and query quality metrics such as KLD alongside performance metrics, with versioned extension payloads for future structured additions.
